name: A Man Working
overview: Scripture presents work as a God-ordained responsibility and blessing, beginning with Adam's commission to tend and keep the garden of Eden (Genesis 2:15). The command to labor six days (Exodus 20:9) underscores the value of diligent effort, while Proverbs highlights the wisdom of industriousness through examples like the ant (Proverbs 6:6) and the rewards of diligent work contrasted with the futility of laziness (Proverbs 12:11; 13:4). Ultimately, labor is portrayed as profitable and sustaining, in contrast to idle talk which leads to lack (Proverbs 14:23).
